title: Copilot Cowork: access Business Applications through Work IQ and use business skills
summary: Hold: Microsoft documents package-deployment automation, so the claim that plugin installation automation is not documented is too broad. The roadmap dates, preview qualification, permissions and consumption model are supported; two Microsoft guides also disagree on the App Access route and environment defaults.
